scenes.name: browser
scenes._source: the page (web/build.sh, served locally) running Golana 1.3 at 100 MHz from a ?script= of the same part on a MacBook, captured through Chrome's DevTools screencast (tools/film_take.mjs); its audio is fm1-live's for the same script (wasm and native agree sample for sample on a single-core firmware), aligned on the LCD's changes (86 of 128 matched, the page's clock 0.05 % slow corrected). The take is 27 s; the scene is its eighth-note stretch
